bulbasaur-frenzy-plant.name: Frenzy Plant
bulbasaur-frenzy-plant.description: Bond skill: colossal roots smash a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 105, Sp. Atk).

bulbasaur-protect.name: Protect
bulbasaur-protect.description: Bond skill: shields itself behind its bulb and is Protected for 1 turn.

bulbasaur-ingrain.name: Ingrain
bulbasaur-ingrain.description: Puts down roots: heals 5% of max HP each turn while engaged with a foe.

bulbasaur-leech-seed.name: Leech Seed
bulbasaur-leech-seed.description: Bond skill: plants a draining seed on a foe up to 2 hexes away, sapping it (Poison) 3 turns.

bulbasaur-sun-soaked-bulb.name: Sun-Soaked Bulb
bulbasaur-sun-soaked-bulb.description: Its bulb soaks up light: heals 4% of max HP at the start of each turn.

bulbasaur-sweet-scent.name: Sweet Scent
bulbasaur-sweet-scent.description: Foes it engages are lured in: they take 15% more damage from its allies.

bulbasaur-sleep-powder.name: Sleep Powder
bulbasaur-sleep-powder.description: New skill: a powder that puts a foe up to 2 hexes away to Sleep for 2 turns.

bulbasaur-magical-leaf.name: Magical Leaf
bulbasaur-magical-leaf.description: New skill: homing leaves strike a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 60), even without line of sight.

bulbasaur-venomous-bloom.name: Venomous Bloom
bulbasaur-venomous-bloom.description: Deals 20% more damage to Poisoned foes.

bulbasaur-sludge-bomb.name: Sludge Bomb
bulbasaur-sludge-bomb.description: New skill: hurls toxic sludge at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 75), Poisoning it for 2 turns.

bulbasaur-growth.name: Growth
bulbasaur-growth.description: New skill: its plant swells with power; it is Focused for 2 turns.

bulbasaur-deep-roots.name: Deep Roots
bulbasaur-deep-roots.description: Its Grass moves drain 10% more of the damage dealt as HP.

bulbasaur-thorny-vines.name: Thorny Vines
bulbasaur-thorny-vines.description: Foes that hit it from an adjacent hex take 6 damage from its thorny vines.

bulbasaur-giga-drain.name: Giga Drain
bulbasaur-giga-drain.description: New skill: drains a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 85), healing by part of the damage.

bulbasaur-sludge-wave.name: Sludge Wave
bulbasaur-sludge-wave.description: New skill: a toxic wave hits every foe within 2 hexes (Power 75) and Poisons them for 1 turn.

bulbasaur-corrosive-sap.name: Corrosive Sap
bulbasaur-corrosive-sap.description: Its damaging hits on adjacent foes Poison them for 2 turns.

bulbasaur-great-flower.name: Great Flower
bulbasaur-great-flower.description: Its huge flower shields its body: takes 10% less damage.

bulbasaur-leaf-storm.name: Leaf Storm
bulbasaur-leaf-storm.description: New skill: a storm of sharp leaves at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 100).

bulbasaur-synthesis.name: Synthesis
bulbasaur-synthesis.description: New skill: turns sunlight into energy; it and adjacent allies heal 50 HP.

bulbasaur-bloom-season.name: Bloom Season
bulbasaur-bloom-season.description: Each combo it lands gives the team 1 Bond.

bulbasaur-lingering-toxins.name: Lingering Toxins
bulbasaur-lingering-toxins.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

bulbasaur-solar-bloom.name: Solar Bloom
bulbasaur-solar-bloom.description: Capstone. Its Grass and Poison moves deal 20% more damage; foes it poisoned spread it when they faint.

bulbasaur-venerable-bloom.name: Venerable Bloom
bulbasaur-venerable-bloom.description: Capstone. Takes 20% less damage at full HP; heals 15% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.
